sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def bbox_glyph(frame,r0,r1,c0,c1,fg='B'):
    c=frame.ascii.split('\n')
    pts=[(r,cc) for r in range(r0,r1+1) for cc in range(c0,c1+1) if c[r][cc]==fg]
    if not pts: return None
    rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
    return tuple(''.join('#' if c[r][cc]==fg else '.' for cc in range(min(cs),max(cs)+1)) for r in range(min(rs),max(rs)+1))
cols=[15,22,29,36,43]
def pink(frame): return [bbox_glyph(frame,51,57,cc-1,cc+5) for cc in cols]
def sig(g): return sum(r.count('#') for r in g) if g else None
print("before p1 pixels:", sig(pink(current_frame)[1]))
# navigate to pos1 (3 LEFT) and set p1 X->L2 (4 UP)
action(['LEFT','LEFT','LEFT','UP','UP','UP','UP'])
p=pink(current_frame)
print("after pink pixels:", [sig(g) for g in p])
print("after p1:", '\n'.join(p[1]) if p[1] else None)
print("result:", {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ['score','done','level_completed','run_complete','game_over','reward']})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
